selected_policy.name: Generic source-defect policy using canonical whole-bar technical exclusion and promoted filtered-ready QA semantics
selected_policy.core_rule: Preserve raw malformed observations unchanged; represent source defect explicitly; exclude the entire invalid bar from technical calculations; apply existing promoted v0.4 filterability criteria and higher-priority fail-closed gates; do not selectively reuse fields without a separately governed field-trust contract.

implementation_authorization_scope: A subsequent bounded gate may align Frozen P0 cache classification/provenance with the existing promoted generic filtered-bar contract. It may not fabricate data, weaken thresholds, run P0, alter Frozen membership, or assume the ASX-8 are READY before validation.

close_range_volume_trust.PME: Close independently corroborated; independent complete row indicates challenged High and Volume are inconsistent. Selected policy still excludes whole challenged raw bar.
close_range_volume_trust.CBA: Observed 155.13 transaction corroborates challenged Close and exceeds challenged High; not complete OHLC authority. Selected policy excludes whole challenged raw bar.
close_range_volume_trust.QAN: Independent 8.89 Close corroboration; not complete OHLC authority. Selected policy excludes whole challenged raw bar.
close_range_volume_trust.ANZ_BSL_BXB_NXT_SDF: No sufficient independent complete/field authority to decide which conflicting field is correct; treat challenged bar as whole-bar technically untrusted.
